title: 第17章 打车去屠龙第18章 沐浴龙血狂暴力量
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
“当然我也是有条件的，”李维想了想，说道，“你之前是芝加哥大学毕业的，那你应该会AP课程的内容吧？微积分、宏观经济学什么的你应该都会吧？”
“当然，”堂吉诃德说道，“你希望我给你补课？”
“只是帮我查漏补缺一下吧，”李维起身，“我有不懂的再问你。”
堂吉诃德兴奋地从沙发上跳了起来，狠狠地抱住李维。
如果不是李维的力量已经增加到了1.1，恐怕堂吉诃德的臭嘴已经要印在李维的脸上了。
他抱了一下李维之后，就兴致勃勃地冲进了卫生间内，开始刮自己脸上的胡须、梳妆打扮。
一番洗漱之后，他就冲出了地下室，跳上车后，飞速地朝着曼哈顿驶去。
等到晚上十点多，李维再次见到堂吉诃德的时候，他发现堂吉诃德似乎从来没有这么开心过。
他拿着手机划开相册一边不停滑动，一边眉飞色舞的讲述着他今天下午是如何和他的小天使度过美好的一天的。
“看，这是我们在中央公园，这是在观光马车上面......这是奇缘3的冻热巧克力，莉莉满脸巧克力的样子是不是很可爱？哈！多漂亮的小花猫......”
李维看着眼前这个男人滔滔不绝地向他炫耀着自己的女儿，过了一会儿他忍不住问道：
“那你呢？”李维说道，“你怎么不在照片里面？”
“我......”堂吉诃德搓了搓手，“我没好意思跟她站在一起，我给她拍拍照片就好了。”
“这就值了，不是吗？我的意思是......这300美金虽然我得攒一个星期，但是我他妈的不后悔，”他扭头看着李维，“我会把钱还给你的，我保证。”
“行了行了，煽情的话以后再说，”李维摆了摆手，“快12点了，该睡觉了。”
堂吉诃德本来酝酿了很久的煽情话夭折在了肚子里，颇有些幽怨地看着李维拉上了隔间的帘子。
台灯关闭，整个地下室内恢复了寂静。
李维却在等着堂吉诃德入睡，现在他一口气支出去了这么多钱，就更要快点把骑士之路的任务做完，这样才能快点拿到钱重新搬出去。
而堂吉诃德这边，或许是因为白天的时候情绪的大起大落而消耗了太多的精力，不到一分钟的时间就倒在了那张被李维撕了一半的床垫上打起了呼噜。
李维听到呼噜声响起之后，悄悄看了一眼手机的时间，估摸着时间差不多了，起身悄悄穿好衣服，等待堂吉诃德开始梦游。

白天在他身上花了3500美金，至少要从他身上多榨几次属性点回来，才能弥补李维内心的痛苦。
不知道过了多久，堂吉诃德的隔间之内，呼噜声突然暂停。
盔甲的碰撞声传来，李维掐好了时间拉开帘子钻了出去。
“你来了，亲爱的侍从！”堂吉诃德神采飞扬的说道，“经过我的探查，我已经从公爵那里得知了找到女巫的方法！”
“尊敬的骑士大人，”李维不动声色地说道，“请问是什么方法？”
“随我来！侍从！”堂吉诃德朝着门外走去，“我们要去找到守护地图的土龙！”
土龙？
content_en:
"Of course I have the conditions," Levi thought for a moment and said, "You graduated from the University of Chicago, so you should know the content of AP courses, right? You should know calculus, macroeconomics, etc., right?"
"Of course," said Don Quixote, "you want me to give you a make-up lesson?"
"Just help me check and fill in the gaps," Levi stood up, "I'll ask you if I don't understand something."
Don Quixote jumped up from the sofa excitedly and hugged Levi tightly.
If Levi's power hadn't increased to 1.1, I'm afraid Don Quixote's bad mouth would have been imprinted on Levi's face.
After hugging Levi, he rushed into the bathroom happily and started shaving his face and dressing up.
After washing up, he rushed out of the basement, jumped into the car, and drove towards Manhattan at high speed.
When Levi saw Don Quixote again at about ten o'clock in the evening, he found that Don Quixote had never seemed so happy.
He opened the photo album on his phone and kept scrolling, while happily telling how he spent a wonderful day with his little angel this afternoon.
"Look, this is us in Central Park, this is on the sightseeing carriage... This is the frozen hot chocolate from Romance 3. Isn't it cute that Lily has her face covered with chocolate? Ha! What a beautiful little cat..."
Levi watched the man in front of him keep showing off his daughter to him. After a while, he couldn't help but ask:
"What about you?" Levi said, "Why aren't you in the photo?"
"I..." Don Quixote rubbed his hands, "I don't have the nerve to stand with her. I can just take a photo of her."
"It's worth it, isn't it? I mean... I have to save the 300 US dollars for a week, but I don't fucking regret it," he turned to look at Levi, "I will return the money to you, I promise."
"Okay, okay, I'll talk about the sensational words later," Levi waved his hand, "It's almost 12 o'clock, it's time to go to bed."
The sensational words that Don Quixote had been brewing for a long time died in his stomach, and he watched with some resentment as Rivera closed the partition curtain.
The lamp was turned off, and silence returned to the entire basement.
Levi was waiting for Don Quixote to fall asleep. Now that he had spent so much money in one go, he had to complete the tasks of the Knight's Road quickly so that he could get the money quickly and move out again.
As for Don Quixote, perhaps he consumed too much energy due to his emotional ups and downs during the day. In less than a minute, he fell on the half-torn mattress by Levi and snored.
After Levi heard the snoring sound, he quietly checked the time on his phone and estimated that it was almost time. He got up and quietly put on his clothes, waiting for Don Quixote to start sleepwalking.
I spent 3,500 US dollars on him during the day, and I had to squeeze at least a few more attribute points from him to make up for the pain in Levi's heart.
I don't know how long it took, but the snoring suddenly stopped in Don Quixote's compartment.
The sound of the collision of armor was heard, and Levi took the time to open the curtain and get out.
"Here you are, my dear squire!" Don Quixote said cheerfully, "After my investigation, I have learned from the Duke how to find the witch!"
"Dear Lord Knight," Levi said calmly, "What is the method?"
"Follow me! Squire!" Don Quixote walked towards the door, "We are going to find the earth dragon guarding the map!"
Earth dragon?
